title: RNA lifetime and transcription speed
description: 829 transcription units with published lifetimes in both exponential and stationary growth. The source contains 847 exponential-phase and 1259 stationary-phase lifetime rows.
processing: Join S4 exponential and S7 stationary transcript lifetimes by exact RNA name. Attach S6 exponential elongation rate by exact operon name when measured. Preserve published lifetime and across-fragment standard deviation. No synthetic decay curves or genomic positions.
limits: Lifetime τ is the exponential time constant, not the half-life; do not relabel as half-life.
Standard deviation describes segments within an RNA, not biological replicate uncertainty.
This dataset contains fitted lifetimes, not the underlying abundance time courses.
Exact-name matching omits transcription units measured in only one phase.
